msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a curvy plus-size Spanish woman in her forties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia moda-guay-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish curvy plus-size Spanish woman in her forties wearing a cream faux-fur zip-up gilet over a cream jumper and cream wide-leg trousers (the one on the left) from the reference, walking at the harbour promenade of Mahón, Menorca, Spain, with white houses and boats, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-guay-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a chocolate brown faux-fur zip-up gilet over a black top and dark trousers (the second from the left) from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-guay-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a cream, burgundy and brown wavy-striped V-neck jumper with white jeans (the second from the left) from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-guay-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a black and white striped polo-collar jumper with jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-guay-29.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a white fluffy knit zip-up cardigan with white trousers (the one on the right) from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
